dialog.title: Upload a dataset
dialog.description: Select a GeoJSON, KML, or zipped Shapefile. GeoNode will ingest and publish it, then Mirante will add it to the map.

dropzone.help: GeoJSON, KML, or zipped Shapefile up to {{size}}

validation.file-too-large: The selected file exceeds the allowed size.
validation.invalid-geojson: The file must contain a valid GeoJSON FeatureCollection.
validation.invalid-kml: The file must contain a valid KML document.
validation.invalid-zip: The file must be a valid ZIP archive containing the components of one Shapefile.
validation.unsupported-format: Supported formats are .geojson, .kml, and .zip containing a Shapefile.

progress.keepOpen: Keep this dialog open until processing finishes.

success.title: Dataset published
success.description: {{name}} was added to the map and the view was fitted to its extent.

errors.title: Dataset could not be published
errors.csrf-unavailable: GeoNode could not start a secure upload session.
errors.network: Mirante could not reach GeoNode. Check the connection and try again.
errors.processing-failed: GeoNode could not process this dataset.
errors.session-expired: Your GeoNode session expired. Sign in again and retry.
errors.timeout: GeoNode took too long to process this dataset.
errors.upload-rejected: GeoNode rejected this upload. Check the file and your permissions.
